title: Half Of Wild California Condor Deaths Come From Lead
hook: We saved 500 California condors, then poisoned their food.
closing: A comeback only lasts if the danger that remains is removed.
question: Should lead ammunition be restricted?

segments.say: California condors rose from 27 to 500, proving extinction was not inevitable.
California condors passed 300 in 2008 and reached 500 by 2023.
Lead poisoning causes 50% of wild condor deaths, turning hunters' leftovers into lethal food.
